text:
henry: hey team, day 2 question  Who is the right person to ask for: VPC peering approvals, certs/kms for private deploys, and who signs off on model QA for a canary? Trying to make a 1-pager for new hires.

katie: welcome Henry! short map: eng-infra handles VPC peering and low-level networking; security/infra handles certs & kms access (people-ops starts the ticket); product signs off on model QA policy, but the feature PM + runtime engineer approve canaries.

sam: to add: eng-platform manages the private deploy orchestration (the policy gates live in platform). If you need a human approver fast for a canary, tag @product + the runtime lead. For emergency cert issues page #eng-oncall.

olivia: quick template you can copy for pages / requests:
```
P1 Page (copyable):
SERVICE: <service-name>
SEVERITY: P1 - rollout causing outage
WHAT: canary failed and rollback triggered, needs urgent intervention
AFFECTED: <region / customer>
CONTACT: <your-name>
```
Use the above for immediate pages, and for non-urgent add a ticket to "rollout-help".

infra-bot: eng-infra office hours Tue/Thu 10:00-11:00 PT. For peering requests file ticket with label "vpc-request".

katie: another note on data residency for private deployments: product + security coordinate region approvals. If your feature processes regulated data, loop in @security-privacy and @product early.

henry: super helpful. Any pointers for who owns the org-level ownership matrix? I want to link names to roles in the 1-pager.

sam: org matrix lives in the onboarding drive; infra leads are Priya & Sam K, runtime lead is Alex R, product head for inference is Jordan. I'll DM the sheet link.

olivia: i'll add this thread summary to the new-hires "who-to-ping" sheet so future hires see it. also tagging the onboarding doc owners to review.

henry: thanks all  bookmarked and will share the 1-pager once it's drafted :thumbsup:
